name: Notfair
description:
NotFair is a universal MCP connector for Claude covering Google Ads, Meta Ads, X Ads, Reddit Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), GoHighLevel and WordPress. Analyze PPC, SEO, analytics and CRM data, then make approved changes from one conversation.

Trusted by 3,000+ businesses. Always free to use, with paid Growth plans available.

Google Ads MCP connector: audit spend, search terms, budgets, bids and conversions; run GAQL reports; research keywords; manage campaigns, ads, audiences, Performance Max and experiments; upload images and attach YouTube videos.

Meta Ads MCP connector: analyze campaigns, audiences and creatives; create and update campaigns and ads; upload images and MP4 videos.

X Ads MCP connector: analyze performance, targeting and creatives; manage campaigns, budgets and audiences; upload image, video and GIF assets.

Reddit Ads MCP connector: analyze campaigns, ad groups, spend and targeting; manage campaigns, budgets, bids and ads.

TikTok Ads MCP connector: analyze campaigns, ad groups, spend, targeting and creatives; manage campaigns, budgets, bids and ads.

LinkedIn Ads MCP connector: analyze B2B performance; manage campaigns, targeting, audiences, lead forms, conversions and creatives.

Google Search Console MCP connector: analyze queries, pages, rankings and CTR; inspect indexing and manage sitemaps.

Google Analytics 4 (GA4) MCP connector: analyze traffic, channels and conversions; run realtime reports and manage custom dimensions and key events.

GoHighLevel MCP connector: manage contacts, conversations, opportunities, pipelines, calendars, appointments, tasks, forms, invoices and payments.

WordPress MCP connector: create and update posts, pages, media and website content.

NotFair uses live APIs and MCP tools. Read-only tools cannot modify accounts. Writes require Claude approval, with history and undo where supported.

Requires a NotFair account and integration. Tools depend on permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Notfair to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Notfair to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://notfair.co/api/mcp/notfair. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Notfair MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notfair provides these MCP tools: execute, executeRead, search, and submitToolFeedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Notfair?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Notfair in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Notfair requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Notfair is developed by NotFair. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
